spans.text: The room, lit with yellow light, is quiet and warm.
Perhaps it's not the ambience that puts you at ease, but also the person here.
Commander... you're here.
Yep. Where are the others?
They're all busy with their own things. This is our personal time, after all.
Shouldn't you be out jogging around now?
Yeah, but I thought you'd come back.
So I decided to wait here for you.
Me? You were waiting for me? Is something the matter?
Mhm. There's something I want to tell you.
Ai stands up. That way she can be closer to you.

I was very scared when I first became a member of Franchouchou. I often thought about the terrible moment when I died, and I often questioned why I was still alive, and how I should live from then on.
But I managed to figure things out after all those practice sessions.
I love the stage, no matter what kind of being I've become.
At first, I thought that since I was alive, I had to hold on until the very end.
Bringing the dazzling stage to everyone was the motivation that drove me to persist.
But I don't think that way anymore. After all, death wasn't the end for me.
Perhaps I can still carry on as long as I can open my eyes and move my body.
Perhaps, for me...
Whether it's singing or dancing, whether it's being guided by or guiding others, whether it's beating my opponent or being crushed by them...
None of these things have been hardships for me. I've never needed to think about why I wanted to hang in there to keep on doing them.
Rather, I've always enjoyed them. These are things I've always loved doing.
...Why are you telling me this all of a sudden?
Ai's voice grows softer, but also more determined.
Are you as passionate about being a manager as I am?
Perhaps I'm not making myself clear enough.
Then let me put it this way—if you had to choose between being Franchouchou's manager or returning to Griffin to continue being a commander there, which would you pick?
Have you thought it through?
If you could only pick one job, who would you rather be, Commander or Manager?
After thinking the matter over for a long time, you give the answer in your heart.
Perhaps those days aren't kind or peaceful ones.
But if I had a chance to do it all over again, I wouldn't be able to abandon those friends of mine or my identity as Commander.
You've always known what you wanted.
That's good.
After thinking the matter over for a long time, you feel that you can't leave Franchouchou.
I think I'd rather be your manager after all.
You're lying!
So rather than being true to yourself, you'd rather help out this pack of zombies called Franchouchou—is that what you're thinking?
I—
If that's what you think, then I'll... I'll look down on you and your convictions.
Sometimes, I think about what death really is for me.
It took me a long time, but I finally managed to figure out the answer. That is to say—
If I couldn't continue living on as an idol, then I'd truly be dead.
That's why you ought to return to where you should be, Commander.
You let out a sigh.
For some reason, I get the feeling that you're going to chase me away.
That's right.
I DO want to chase you away.
Uh, why is that?
I thought you didn't hate me anymore after all we'd been through together.
Of course not.
Rather than hate, it's more like...
Anyway, before we part, I want to give you a present.
Ai hands you an oblong-shaped object wrapped in a handkerchief.
You unwrap it and see that it is a brand new lunchbox, identical to the one Ai uses every day.
Huh? A lunchbox?
Hm, is it the same kind as the one you use?
I'm sorry that it's not branded stuff or rare or special or anything.
However, it's just as essential and as much a part of me as breathing, eating, sleeping or being an idol.
It isn't some rare treasure, but something that's been slowly, gradually hidden in the flow of time and which has become an inseparable part of myself.
I carried it with me whenever I did odd jobs, and it was always filled with the encouragement and energy that my friends gave me.
And now, I want to be the same thing to you, Commander. After all, you've depended on all of that to get to where you are, haven't you?
Yeah, you're... a part of my life.
Then please accept it.
Although I can't help you out if you gave me seven days, let alone just three...
I'll continue cheering you on with these feelings in my heart! So do your best, Commander, and Franchouchou's Manager!
You meet Ai's gaze, and the two of you exchange smiles.
True understanding has never needed words, after all.
